original_criteria.criterion: Compare pressure increments rather than treating the initial headspace as a vacuum.
Use the actual gas-phase moles and temperature in P = nRT/V; O2 and N2 need not dissolve equally.
Compare gas-phase fractions of the added material, not pressure alone.
The CO2 vessel should store more of the dose in the liquid under these conditions.
Compare carbon partition fractions at the actual temperatures.
The alkaline vessel retains the added carbon; pressure reduction alone must not be mistaken for carbon deletion.
Compare dissolved-carbon fractions, not just the raw pressure difference.
Check whether the runtime uses temperature-dependent partition data; fixed-Henry behaviour is a model limitation.
The acid trap has a larger ammonium fraction and a smaller gas-phase NH3 fraction.
All added nitrogen is accounted for in each vessel; the acidified solution need not become neutral.
Carbonate/bicarbonate decline after acidification while headspace CO2 increases.
Total carbon is conserved across the capture–release cycle, apart from explicitly recorded initial air contributions.
First verify that the CO2-rich stage dissolved a measurable calcium fraction.
After sweeping, check for increased calcium-carbonate solid and include swept carbon in the balance.
Total pressure rises, but total carbon remains unchanged.
Compare CO2 partial pressure and dissolved-carbon fraction before and after; account for thermal and nonideal corrections.
Pressure stays near the setpoint while headspace volume expands.
Track carbon conservation and any decrease in dissolved-carbon fraction; do not assume regulation vents mass.
Compare neutral dissolved CO2 separately from bicarbonate/carbonate and gas-phase carbon.
If the partition model lacks a salinity correction, record the missing effect as unsupported rather than forcing an expected difference.

scope: Recompute from raw owned phase amounts, finite-headspace volume and actual temperature. Inventory includes trapped air; no pressure-only dose inference. Returned aqueous solution diagnostics are not additional matter. Residuals are retained numerically without a new fitted pass band. Gas law agreement does not prove partition chemistry, acid trapping, salinity, energy or empirical validation.
